translation_rules.aliases: Identical translated bytes share one packed stream.
translation_rules.logical_voice_assignment: Selected tone streams map in source order to tones 0 through 2; the selected noise stream maps to noise.
translation_rules.parallel_merge: Commands are merged by cumulative source duration; equal-tick commands use logical-voice order.
translation_rules.stream_end: Each source voice emits MUTE at its cumulative end tick; the merged cue then emits END.
